_meta.label: Squamous cell carcinoma

settings.label: Adjuvant after radical hysterectomy (FIGO 2009 IA2–IIA): intermediate risk (Sedlis) or high risk (Peters)
Definitive chemoradiation for locally advanced disease (FIGO 2009 IB2–IVA / 2018 IB3–IVA), including induction and immunotherapy
First-line systemic therapy for recurrent, persistent or metastatic disease (radiosensitising cisplatin allowed)
Second line and beyond (after platinum ± bevacizumab ± PD-(L)1)
Neoadjuvant chemotherapy before surgery (bulky IB–IIB) vs chemoradiation

tiers.1: OS benefit, replicated (≥2 randomised trials or a class effect confirmed by meta-analysis / non-inferiority)
tiers.2: OS benefit, single phase 3 (CI excludes 1 as printed), or non-inferior to a regimen that has one
tiers.3: OS benefit borderline: disease-specific survival only, interim, randomised phase II, or printed without HR / CI
tiers.4: PFS / DFS / recurrence benefit only; no OS benefit shown
tiers.5: No efficacy difference vs the comparator, or the comparator that lost: chosen on toxicity, or when the better option cannot be given
tiers.6: No phase 3: single-arm, non-randomised comparison, retrospective, design-only or extrapolated
tiers.7: Do not use: OS or PFS/DFS significantly worse than the alternative, negative trial, or histotype excluded from the trial

_meta.tier_reading: Squamous cell carcinoma is 72–94% of every cervical trial, so the trial-wide result sets the tier; SCC subgroups (KEYNOTE-826, COMPASSION-16, BEATcc, EMPOWER-Cervical 1, innovaTV 301, STARS, JCOG0505) are printed as qualifiers and fits. SCC-only trials (NCIC CTG, GOG-169, Bonomi, CheckMate 358, GOG-227C, irinotecan, docetaxel, gemcitabine, GOG 76-U, JCOG 0102, Gupta) apply directly. PD-L1 CPS ≥1 is the only treatment-selecting biomarker (91% of SCC).
_meta.scope: Efficacy figures copied from data/trials_*.json (vault notes v1.1, full-text checked 2026-09-25); toxicity resolved from data/tox.json via tox_ref {trial, arm}; label rules from data/labels.json and data/drug_rules.json. 'base' inherits every field the record does not set from the named SCC record.
